item.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction set for Los Angeles, with many big names skipping the stage
item.description: The Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony on Saturday may feel like an '80s night. New members include Billy Idol, Phil Collins, Sade, Queen Latifah, New Order, Luther Vandross, and Iron Maiden.

item.title: Alaska voters reject ballot measure seeking to repeal open primaries, ranked voting system
item.description: Alaska voters have rejected a ballot measure seeking to repeal the state’s unique system of open primaries and ranked choice voting in general elections.

item.title: Kreiss-Tomkins becomes first Democrat since 1998 elected governor in Alaska
item.description: Alaska voters have elected a Democrat for governor for the first time since 1998. Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins, a former state lawmaker, defeated three Republicans.

item.title: Democrats try out a strange new emotion at post-midterms What's Next conference: Hope

item.title: 'The Sun Also Rises' at 100: Women are now leaders in Hemingway scholarship
